notes: Reviewed 2026-11-15: N-limited steady state (0 h) is nutrient_limited_growth | Ammonium-limited chemostat (D = 0.2 h-1) with a plug-flow loop that gives repeated short nitrogen starvation. t0 steady state (before PFR connection) = treatment none; WT t0 = control. 5 min samples = acute, 28 h samples = adapted (repeated stimulus for 28 h). Chemostat medium is not named (preculture is 'minimal media'), so base_medium/medium_class/carbon_source left out; temperature during the continuous phase not stated (batch phase 28-30 C). SR is a 'knock-out of stringent response' without gene names: genotype_class deletion, perturbed_genes left out, global_regulator_perturbed true inferred (stringent response = relA/spoT); SR strain background not stated, so strain_group/strain_name only for MG1655.

culture_mode.q: The chemostat was operated at a dilution rate of D = 0.2 h-1 and ammonium was chosen as the limiting nutrient.

is_control.q: The steady state prior to the PFR connection was used as reference state (S0: t = 0 h).
